node_greeting.speaker: Bast
node_greeting.text: The young man by the door watches you come closer without seeming to move at all. "You're new," he says pleasantly. It is not quite a greeting. "Everyone's new, first time through a story."

choices.text: And whose story is this one?
You talk about him like he's already gone.

node_whose.speaker: Bast
node_whose.text: "His." A nod toward the bar, gentle as anything. "But not the man you see. The man the road made first — red hair, temper like a lute string, always one lesson away from disaster or brilliance. Usually both." He smiles. "Watch closely."

node_gone.speaker: Bast
node_gone.text: "Gone? No." The pleasantness thins, just slightly. "Buried is not gone. It's merely... waiting for someone stubborn enough to dig. Which is why we keep the stories alive, reshi — even the ones that cost him everything."

node_road.speaker: Bast
node_road.text: "Go on, then. The door's behind you, and the road's beyond that." His eyes catch the firelight. "Start where all his roads started: a caravan rolling out at first light, and a boy who had no idea what it would cost him."
